image_description: A black and white photograph showing a large, elongated airship (dirigible) flying over a dense urban cityscape. The airship has a smooth, cigar-shaped envelope with visible text on the side and a gondola suspended beneath the forward section. The background features numerous buildings under a cloudy sky.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text on the side of the airship, but it is slightly blurry and indistinct. While it resembles letters, it lacks the sharpness of real typography, suggesting minor AI generation artifacting in text rendering.

The buildings in the background have a slightly 'smudged' or painterly texture rather than sharp architectural details, which is common in AI-generated backgrounds where fine detail consistency is challenging.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out misclassification as a generic cloud or other aerial object.
To verify the spatial relationship between the airship and the city, ensuring the airship is correctly positioned in the foreground/mid-ground without melting into the sky.
To check for edge bleeding between the smooth envelope and the sky, ensuring a clean, continuous boundary.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the hull, checking for gibberish or character fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the airship's elongated shape
Clarity and realism of the text on the envelope
Boundary separation between the airship and the sky
Consistency of lighting and perspective between the airship and the city below
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the airship; AI often struggles with coherent lettering on curved surfaces. Also, verify if the gondola connects logically to the hull without floating or merging artifacts. Check if the background city has consistent perspective lines.
